source.prompt: Square, 2048x2048. Orthographic view looking straight down on nine separate single leaves in a 3x3 grid, each centred in its third of the frame with magenta all round it, on a solid flat bright magenta (#ff00ff) background that fills everything outside the objects, with no shadow cast on the background. Flat, even, shadowless lighting: no highlights, no vignette. No perspective, no text, no border, no watermark. Objects: the fleshy spoon-shaped rosette leaves of a high-alpine succulent, each leaf a thick, slightly cupped spatula with a rounded tip and a narrow base, a fine pale waxy bloom over a grey-green surface, faint parallel veins, the tip a little reddened on three of them; all nine the same size and pointing the same way, base at the bottom of their cell. Keep colours natural but slightly muted and even, so the texture can be tinted to different palettes without looking stained.
source.reuse: the southern highlands' snail-shell rosettes, a leaf a cell (3 x 3; biomes/shighlands station fellfield, to wire on the whorl); any fleshy spatulate rosette leaf
